cases.name: Margaret Dubignon Buffin
cases.about: Her obituary said, (Margaret was) affectionately known as “Mella Yella.” She received her education at R.E. Lee Institute. Mella Yella was a loving, caring, and sharing person who never met a stranger. She would talk, laugh, and give good advice to anyone. She would give you the shirt off her back. She loved spending time with her family, especially her grandchildren. She loved to dance, cook, and eat.
cases.narrative: On 10/21/2023, her family found her body was found hidden inside of a large suitcase in the closet of her apartment.
